text:
Priya (support): FYI customer Finwave just escalated — they saw ~2x token usage for a 10m window after a bunch of 504s. Dashboard shows normal request counts, invoice has ~1.9M extra tokens. Ticket #12345. Can we triage? :eyes:

Sam (billing): on it. Can you paste any ledger IDs or request ids from the timeframe? I want to run a dedupe query first.

Priya (support): pulled a few correlated logs from ingress (redacted):
```
2026-03-15T18:02:12Z INGRESS req_id=fin-req-8a3b status=504 upstream_msg="timeout"
2026-03-15T18:02:14Z INGRESS RESEND req_id=fin-req-8a3b status=200 idempotency_key="-" tokens=2345
2026-03-15T18:02:14Z METERING ledger_entry_id=ledg-9912 customer=finwave tokens=2345 source=req:fin-req-8a3b
2026-03-15T18:02:20Z INGRESS RESEND req_id=fin-req-8a3b status=200 idempotency_key="-" tokens=2345 duplicate_count=2
```
Looks like the server processed the same request body multiple times and the logs show idempotency_key is missing (`-`). Customer says their client sets idempotency keys (~100 char GUID).

Ajay (infra): interesting — edge-proxy v2.1.3 had a bug where headers above 64 bytes get quietly truncated (we recently reverted the header-multiplexing change for http2). If the client IDEMP key was longer than the proxy header buffer, it would be cut off and the backend saw no idempotency header.

Ella (engineer): confirmed on staging with a replay: when Idempotency-Key header is truncated it becomes an empty string on the backend and our idempotency table uses the header value as the primary dedupe key. No fallback fingerprinting is implemented for POST /v1/generate. Repro steps I ran:
```bash
# simulate long idempotency header hitting edge proxy
curl -v -H "Idempotency-Key: $(python -c 'print("x"*120)')" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-1","input":"hello"}' https://edge.redwood.test/v1/generate
# observe logs: backend sees Idempotency-Key: ""
```

Triage Bot: automated alert: suspected duplicate-metering spike for customer=finwave, window=2026-03-15T18:00:00Z..2026-03-15T18:15:00Z.

Sam (billing): thanks. Next steps from billing side: 1) identify ledger entries that have identical request fingerprints but multiple charges, 2) hold invoice lines for Finwave and prepare provisional refund. Example query I will run (ad-hoc):
```sql
SELECT request_hash, COUNT(*) as hits, SUM(tokens) as tokens_total
FROM metering_entries
WHERE customer_id='finwave' AND ts >= '2026-03-15T18:00:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-15T18:15:00Z'
GROUP BY request_hash
HAVING hits > 1;
```
(we compute request_hash = sha256(method || path || body) when idempotency_key is missing, if available).

Priya (support): customer says their SDK recently rotated to 128-char id keys; they can shorten keys as a temporary workaround. They've asked for a credited refund asap.

Ajay (infra): I can push a hotfix to edge-proxy that increases header buffer to 256 bytes and ensures we pass the full Idempotency-Key through. Will run to staging first. Patch summary: bump HEADERS_MAX_LEN to 256 and add a tracing log when header is truncated.

Ella (engineer): parallel fix: add server-side fallback dedupe using request fingerprint for POST /v1/generate for a 5-minute window when idempotency_key is empty. Patch ready in PR #3421, needs review. This will prevent replays from double-counting when the header is absent.

Sam (billing): once we have dups from the SQL query I will: mark duplicates, issue provisional credit for tokens_total where hits > 1 and await confirmation. Please post ledger ids here.

Priya (support): Posted sample ledger ids: ledg-9912, ledg-9913, ledg-9914. Customer onboarded; they want the credit and the timeline for a permanent fix.

Ajay (infra): rolling header buffer patch to staging now (staging tag edge-proxy:canary-2.1.4). ETA prod rollout 3 hours after smoke tests + 30m soak.

Triage Bot: CI check: PR #3421 (server fallback) has failing unit test in dedupe module; @Ella can you address?

Ella (engineer): fixing tests, will re-run. If green, aim to merge in 2h and ship to canary.

Sam (billing): found duplicate groups: 42 request_hash groups with hits between 2..4 totaling 1,876,420 tokens. Preparing provisional credit of 1,876,420 tokens for Finwave; finance notified.

Priya (support): told customer: provisional credit issued pending final reconciliation, patch timelines: header buffer + server fallback in canary today, prod in ~4h if all good. Customer replied :thumbsup: and asked to confirm once prod is live.

Ajay (infra): prod rollout started, monitoring token ingestion for Finwave. Will post rollback window.

Ella (engineer): merged fallback dedupe PR, canary looks good. Fallback prevents reprocess of identical bodies without idempotency header for 5m.

Sam (billing): finance approved final credit. I'll update invoice and mark refund processed.

Priya (support): Closing loop with customer. Finwave confirmed invoice corrected after refund, will shorten idempotency keys by SDK patch too.

Ajay (infra): post-mortem noted: edge-proxy header-size regression, add e2e tests for long idempotency headers and token-level billing monitors.

Priya (support): tagging follow-ups: @Ajay to add header e2e, @Ella to add server fingerprinting test, @Sam confirm refund on invoice; I'll attach closure notes to ticket #12345 and send customer summary. Thanks team :heart:
